title: Introduction to Superconductivity
abstract: M Tinkham Maidenhead: McGraw Hill 1975 pp xiv + 296 price £11.50 Professor Tinkham writes with clarity, emphasizing the physical ideas underlying the theoretical approaches to superconductivity which form the basis of this excellent book. By avoiding certain techniques, such as the use of Green functions, and by analysing many practical situations, he has ensured that the text is accessible to graduate experimentalists and theoreticians alike.
